assumptions.role: Supplies the finite candidate dynamics and true intervention supports.
assumptions.statement: The physical fixture is a planted three-level ternary laminar controller circuit over 27 binary leaves.

assumptions.role: Supplies recursive operational closure without adaptation.
assumptions.statement: At every admitted level, majority summary followed by downward broadcast is the physical controller.

assumptions.role: Defines identity, essential variables, and the perturbation family.
assumptions.statement: The viable region is exact return to the initial all-zero codeword under one support-local perturbation.

assumptions.role: Separates update opportunity, action, and durable record.
assumptions.statement: A durable record is appended only after a controller changes a child and verifies recovery.

assumptions.role: Makes closure-latency ratios computable without inventing units.
assumptions.statement: One causal edge propagation is the primitive dimensionless opportunity interval; no dimensional time or length is supplied.

comparators: ordinary majority coarse-graining without downward repair

concept.invariant: Each admitted level has an intervention-supported boundary, active viability advantage, typed upward record map, typed downward repair map, and explicit record/clock denominator.

equations: r_ell(q): broadcast q to every dissenting child
V=1 iff the post-control microstate equals the initial codeword
falsifiers: planted m=3 fails any held-out disturbance in the declared family
m=4 earns new survival rather than only added complexity
an arbitrary partition matches the observed physical intervention supports

free_choices.choice: Ternary branching, 27 leaves, and three planted levels.
free_choices.sensitivity_test: Compare m=0..4 and record that m4 is nonidentified without a complexity penalty.
free_choices.why_not_forced: No DU result selects branching three or this finite depth.

free_choices.choice: Exact all-zero recovery is the viability objective.
free_choices.sensitivity_test: The ordinary-RG and two-child regime-shift controls expose those alternative readings.
free_choices.why_not_forced: A root-only or coherence-only objective would count damaged or identity-flipped states as viable.

free_choices.choice: MDL cost is failures plus 0.1 per controller channel.
free_choices.why_not_forced: The tradeoff is a declared model-selection preference.

free_choices.choice: Controller response supports are admitted physical interventions.
free_choices.sensitivity_test: Compare the planted support family with an interleaved tree and an overlapping coalition.
free_choices.why_not_forced: Without interventions, many arbitrary ternary trees are equally recursively viable on matched environments.

free_choices.choice: Closure latency is 2d+1 primitive opportunities at depth d.
free_choices.sensitivity_test: Keep latency ratios separate from event-driven durable-record counts and from dimensional physical time.
free_choices.why_not_forced: It follows only from the planted propagation/verification circuit.

observables: exact microstate recovery under training and held-out disturbances

result.claim: A planted recursive controller can conditionally select three intervention-supported response/record levels and dimensionless closure ratios, while recursion alone does not select the partition, depth penalty, physical units, adaptation, or cosmology.
result.grade: EXACT FINITE CONDITIONAL CONSTRUCTION / SCOPED SYSTEM-4 NECESSITY COUNTERMODEL / PHYSICAL ONTOLOGY OPEN
result.remaining_uncertainty: No DU dynamics selects the controller tree, disturbance family, identity region, branching, record law, edge unit, or objective; the fixed regulator fails an out-of-family disturbance and supplies no adaptation or self-authoring mechanism.

stop_conditions: Stop physical recursion if boundaries exist only in analyst-selected partitions.
Stop clock language if quiet opportunities are counted as durable records.
Stop scale language at dimensionless ratios without a microscopic unit.
Stop full-VSM or System-4 language because no adaptation channel is constructed.
Stop cosmological extrapolation because no geometry, Lorentz, gravity, or Lambda map exists.

comparison_receipt.note: Contract completeness means legible and comparable, not physically true. Warrant types are non-ordinal; computation or formal argument disposes.

prior-vision_audit.new_physical_construction: Yes, but only a finite recursive error-correcting regulator with typed upward/downward maps and durable record channels.
prior-vision_audit.vision_decomposition: S1-S5 functions, recursive system depth, and finality/scale strata are independent axes; the fixture repeats a lean closure passport without repeating Beer's exact five-function organization.
prior-vision_audit.vision_narrowing: Operational viability under a fixed disturbance family does not require System 4. The fixture fails a changed disturbance regime, so adaptation and self-authoring remain open rather than solved.

records_clocks_and_scales.clock_interpretation: These are event-driven verified-closure records and causal latencies, not a universal proper-time clock.

resolution_and_covariance.resolution_interpretation: Depth is relative to admitted resolution; adjacent maps commute rather than asserting one absolute universal m.
